programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Box Fort; Pups Save Travelin' Travis From Really Big Bill
programs.desc: The Pups must save Rocky and Humdinger from a runaway box fort; when Skye helps Traveling Travis search for Big Bill Island, the misguided explorer gets carried away by a really, really big bird.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save Queen Cluck-Cluck; Pups Save a Desert Flounder
programs.desc: Mayor Goodway dreams she's traveled to the mysterious Cluck Cluck Island, a very strange land where Chickaletta is royalty; Traveling Travis' balloon gets caught on the Flounder.

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.sub_title: Piggy in the Middle; Pancakes; Thunderstorm; Daddy's Movie; Bicycles
programs.desc: Peppa teases George; Mummy Pig makes pancakes; Peppa and George hear a strange noise; Daddy Pig gets a new movie camera; Peppa's friends ride their bicycles.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Trash-Dinger; Pups Save the Royal Armor
programs.desc: When Mayor Humdinger's trash-compacting truck messes up the beach, Rocky's new Re-Use It Truck comes to the rescue; when a gift of armor for the Princess gets scattered all over town, Rocky uses his Re-Use It Truck to put the armor back together.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Rescue Wheels: Pups Save the Teetering Tower; Rescue Wheels: Pups Save the Spelunkers
programs.desc: When Speed Meister's rollercoaster sends a pet playdate out of control, Rubble and Crew save the day with a bigger, better, and safer coaster; the Bark Yard safety inspection is set for today.

programs.title: Mr. Crocodile
programs.sub_title: Birthday Party; Tick Tock Mr. Croc
programs.desc: Mr. Crocodile wants to be a good guest at Daisy's birthday party since he's never been to one before; rushing to get to a concert on time, Mr. Crocodile and Daisy misplace their tickets at Mom's Box and Ship Shop.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Rescue Knights: Quest for the Dragon's Tooth
programs.desc: When Ryder and the pups are knighted by the Princess of Barkingburg, they're put to the test when a disgruntled ex-Knight gains control of a dragon and attacks the castle.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Search and Rescue: Pups Save the Bike Race
programs.desc: In Adventure Bay, a major bike race is underway, and nearly the entire town is participating; with so many bikes on the roads, maintaining safety is a challenge; Chase and his team of Safety and Rescue Pups are on the job.

programs.title: Rubble & Crew
programs.sub_title: The Crew Builds a Pig Barn; The Crew Builds a Giant Runway
programs.desc: A new farmer in town asks Rubble & Crew to build a barn for her pig in time for the big Pig Party; Motor's super special birthday present gets delayed, and the pups realize Builder Cove's airport needs a bigger runway.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Jungle Pups: Pups Find a Hidden Jungle
programs.desc: Ryder and the pups visit a hidden jungle and must use their new animal vehicles to help Tracker rescue the animal inhabitants from the hot lava and save their home.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Rescue Knights: Pups Save a Dozing Dragon
programs.desc: When the Duke and Claw use a magic cauldron to put the people of Barkingburg to sleep, their plan backfires when the enchanted fog works on Sparks; it's up to the PAW Patrol to wake up the Dragon along with everyone else in town.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Stop a Super Shaker; Pups Save a Flying Farmhouse
programs.desc: Farmer Al's harvest machine goes haywire and shakes up Adventure Bay, even threatening to rock the Lookout off its foundation; Farmer Al has a wild dream that the PAW Patrol must rescue him and Yumi when his animals start acting like humans.
